description: Synthetic Conductor repositories and a workspace history export for selfhost migrate conductor. Nothing here comes from a real Conductor install: the settings follow Conductor's published docs and settings schema, and the export follows the objects of its published API, since the format of Conductor's account export (Settings, Account, Export data) is not published.

files.repos/acme-web/.conductor/settings.toml: shared settings: a multi-line setup that runs script/setup-db.sh, an archive script, run_mode nonconcurrent, four named actions (args, options.cwd, available_in, icon, hide, default), environment_variables with local and cloud tables and a secret-named key, prompts, git, preview_urls, file_include_globs, and two keys the schema does not have (notify_on_finish, scripts.teardown)
files.repos/acme-web/.conductor/settings.local: one machine's overrides, which migrate lists but does not move
files.repos/acme-web/conductor.json: a legacy file that Conductor ignores while .conductor/settings.toml exists
files.repos/acme-web/script/setup-db.sh: a script the setup runs; reads CONDUCTOR_WORKSPACE_NAME, CONDUCTOR_PORT and CONDUCTOR_IS_LOCAL
files.repos/acme-web/selfhost.toml: an existing selfhost.toml with comments and one rule, which migrate must keep byte for byte
files.repos/legacy-api/conductor.json: the legacy example from Conductor's conductor.json docs
files.repos/no-settings/README.md: a repository with no Conductor settings
files.export/workspaces/lisbon.json: an archived workspace (GET /v0/workspaces/{id}) with two Claude sessions and their transcript messages nested under sessions and messages
files.export/workspaces/porto.json: a cloud workspace with no repoUrl (the repository comes from its project), one Codex session and one session with no messages or timestamps
files.export/sessions/ses_osaka_1.messages.jso: GET /v0/sessions/{id}/messages page for a session known otherwise only from transcripts.json
files.export/transcripts.json: POST /v0/sql response with rows of session_transcripts_view
files.export/notes.txt: a file that is not JSON, which the importer does not read
